title: Flat Troll Blue 16-Inch Triple Tier Wall Mount Glass Shelf With Integrated Towel Bar, Tempered Beveled Glass And Solid Brass Hardware, Allied Brass
body_html:
Finished in Flat Troll Blue, get countertop space back while keeping towels and daily essentials neatly organized—this wall-mounted glass shelf adds storage without clutter, which presents a distinctive, muted blue-gray tone that adds artistic character to contemporary bathroom designs. to match any decor, it’s built with tempered glass and solid brass hardware for lasting bathroom performance.

  • Flat Troll Blue creates a distinctive focal point
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Count on durable materials: 3/8-inch tempered, beveled-edge glass paired with brass hardware.
  • Make the most of wall space—wall mount installation helps free up vanity and floor space.
  • Choose a finish that coordinates with your traditional bathroom hardware and classic bath accessories.

Why it lasts: Solid brass hardware provides enduring strength for everyday use.

Specs

  • Product type: Triple tier wall mount glass shelf with integrated towel bar
  • Glass size: 16 x 5 in
  • Overall dimensions: 16 in (L) x 5 in (W) x 18 in (H)
  • Glass thickness: 0.38 in (3/8 in)
  • Material: Brass hardware with tempered glass
  • Weight capacity: 6 lb
  • Mounting: Wall mount, concealed screw mounting
  • Included: Glass shelf and all installation hardware
  • Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4"
  • Assembly required: No
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Complete your bathroom with matching pieces from the Allied Brass Collection of products.
meta_description: 16-inch wall mount glass shelf with integrated towel bar, triple-tier storage, 3/8-in tempered beveled glass and brass hardware. Limited warranty.
